parameters.name: AccessRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where you access the PrivateZone service.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: HostRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service is deployed.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
